data.name: Bishan
data.long_meaning: The name Bishan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vishnu’, meaning 'abode of all'. It is a name bestowed upon those who are believed to be blessed and fortunate. This name carries the blessings of Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe and the embodiment of love, compassion, and wisdom.
